model_annotation: The plot illustrates training loss as a function of iteration for six methods listed in the legend (Vanilla, StrmLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H), SepLLM (n=64, H/T), and SepLLM (n=128)), each shown as a colored line with a faint, semi-transparent band around it. The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 140,000 with regularly spaced tick labels at 20,000-iteration intervals (0, 20k, 40k, …, 140k). The y-axis is labeled “Loss,” uses a linear scale, and spans approximately 2.4 to 3.4 with tick labels appearing at 0.1 increments (2.4, 2.5, …, 3.4). The Vanilla curve is drawn in purple as a solid line (with a purple band) and drops steeply from about 3.4 near iteration 0 to roughly 2.7 by around 10,000 iterations, then declines more gradually to about 2.48–2.50 by 140,000. StrmLLM (n=64) is shown in light blue as a solid line (with a light-blue band) and similarly falls from about 3.4 near iteration 0 to about 2.85–2.9 by around 10,000, then decreases slowly to around 2.61–2.62 by 140,000. SepLLM (n=64) is shown in orange as a solid line (with an orange band), dropping from about 3.4 at the start to roughly 2.75–2.8 by ~10,000 and then tapering down to about 2.52–2.53 by 140,000. SepLLM (n=64, H) is shown in green as a solid line (with a green band), decreasing from about 3.4 near iteration 0 to around 2.74–2.78 by ~10,000 and then continuing downward to about 2.51–2.52 by 140,000. SepLLM (n=64, H/T) is shown in red as a solid line (with a red band), falling from about 3.4 initially to approximately 2.72–2.76 by ~10,000, then gradually reaching about 2.50–2.51 near 140,000. SepLLM (n=128) is shown in a darker blue as a solid line (with a matching band), dropping from about 3.4 at iteration 0 to roughly 2.70–2.75 by ~10,000 and then slowly declining to around 2.49–2.50 by 140,000.
